neighbours.label: colon ':' joining two clauses in archaic or literary prose (biblical / legal style), with a weaker secondary trigger on ' deliver'
fire: And the elders said unto the people: go ye up and possess the land which the LORD hath given you.
Thou shalt keep the feast seven days in the place which the LORD shall choose: for he shall bless thee in all thine increase.
The corporation is an artificial person: it has a will and an understanding peculiar to itself.
Then spake the prophet unto the king: thy kingdom shall be taken from thee and given to another.
Wisdom is better than rubies: and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
The law is a jealous mistress: it demands of its servants a lifetime of patient devotion.
Blessed are the meek in spirit: for theirs shall be the peace that passeth all understanding.
The state, said the old philosopher, is a living body: it grows, it sickens, and in time it dies.
quiet: And the elders said unto the people that they should go up and possess the land which the LORD had given them.
Thou shalt keep the feast seven days in the place which the LORD shall choose, and he shall bless thee in all thine increase.

Then spake the prophet unto the king, and he told him that his kingdom would be taken from him.
Wisdom is better than rubies, and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
The law is a jealous mistress and demands of its servants a lifetime of patient devotion.
Blessed are the meek in spirit, and theirs shall be the peace that passeth all understanding.

notes: Card: ':' is 19 of the top 32 (KJV-style and essayistic clause colons); ' deliver' x5. Near misses keep the same prose but join clauses with a semicolon or comma.
